scripts.title: Auto Rhythm Script
scripts.script:
-- https://discord.gg/B3HqPPzFYr - HalloweenGaster (the server is mostly related to scripts for undertale based games, script requests are very rarely accepted)
getgenv().G = true
while getgenv().G do
wait()
local m = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Rhythm.MainFrame.point.Position.X.Scale
local z = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Rhythm.MainFrame.Bars:GetChildren()
for i,d in z do
local res = m-d.Position.X.Scale
local item = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Rhythm")

if res > -0.01 and res < 0.01 and item then
item:Activate()
end

end
end
